app.name: Zira
app.supportStatement: Zira does not decide; it supports the decision of the agronomist and the farmer.

placeholder.note: This screen gets its content in Phase {phase}. Only the frame is ready for now.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Shows the state of the system in ten seconds; no analysis happens here.
items: Registered fields and the last NASA data update
Completed and pending analyses
Alerts for missing data, sensor faults and risk
Map of field locations

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Every field is an independent record with its own profile: location, soil, crop, irrigation.
items: Add a field by drawing its boundary on a map
Soil type, rainfed or irrigated, crop and variety
Field detail page and analysis status

fieldMemory.title: Field Memory
fieldMemory.description: Works out from satellite imagery whether the field was cropped or fallow in each of the last 10 seasons.
items: 10-year NDVI time series
Cropped and fallow periods, with a confidence level
Warnings for cloudy or missing imagery
Confirmation by the user and the agronomist

waterVault.title: Water Vault
waterVault.description: Shows how many millimetres of usable water the soil holds on the decision day.
items: Precipitation, irrigation input, ET0 and ETc
Daily water balance and usable water (mm)
Satellite versus sensor difference and the uncertainty range
Pick a date to see the past water balance

rotation.title: Rotation and Zira Card
rotation.description: Compares three rotation strategies on the same field under the same conditions.
items: A: current rotation, B: water-dependent flexible rotation, C: legume rotation
In how many of 25 seasons the water was enough, with its uncertainty range
Rationale, data evidence, benefit, information gap and local review risk for each strategy
Zira Card preview and agronomist approval

dataCenter.title: Data Center
dataCenter.description: Shows that NASA data really arrives and is processed.
items: Connection status of POWER, Landsat, MODIS, SMAP, GPM and GRACE
Last successful fetch and the fetch history
Missing or faulty records and API error logs

settings.title: Settings
items: Users and roles
Cooperative and institution records
API keys and configuration

dashboard.noFields: No fields yet. Start by adding the first one.
dashboard.mapAria: Map showing where the fields are
dashboard.mapEmpty: There are no fields to show on the map.
dashboard.mapLegend: Solid dot: NASA data is available. Faint dot: not fetched yet.

fields.emptyDescription: Draw the boundary on the map to add the first field. NASA data is fetched for its centre point.

form.title: New field
form.description: Enter the field's name, soil and boundary. The area and the centre point are calculated from the boundary.
form.name: Field name
form.soilHint: Available water capacity {low}–{high} mm/m. The middle of the range is used until a sensor calibrates it.
form.mapHint: Click the map to mark the corners of the field. At least three corners are needed.
form.mapAria: Map for drawing the field boundary
form.goToError: Write the latitude and longitude as "37.90, 32.50".

errors.needPolygon: Mark at least three corners on the map.
errors.invalidPolygon: The boundary is not valid: its edges must not cross.
errors.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
errors.generic: The field could not be saved. Try again.

detail.elevationPending: Set when NASA data is fetched

weather.title: NASA POWER daily climate data
weather.description: Precipitation, temperature, humidity, wind, solar radiation and pressure for the field's centre point over 25 years. POWER is a regional product: it is not presented as a measurement taken on the field.
weather.fetchFailed: The data could not be fetched
weather.none: There is no NASA data for this field yet.
weather.chartAria: Bar chart of total precipitation for each year
weather.windNote: Wind is measured at {height} m and converted to 2 m for evapotranspiration.

errors.queue: The job queue cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
errors.generic: The fetch could not be started. Try again.
errors.slow: The fetch is taking longer than expected. You can follow it in the Data Center.

dataCenter.regionalNote: Regional satellite and model data is never presented as a direct measurement of a single field.
dataCenter.notConnected: The Earth Engine sources connect in phase 5.
dataCenter.jobsEmpty: There are no fetch jobs yet.
dataCenter.cached: from the cache, no new rows

roles.power: Daily climate inputs: precipitation, temperature, humidity, wind, radiation
roles.gpm: Precipitation series; cross-check for POWER precipitation
roles.modis: Regional phenology; support for cloudy Landsat periods
